caption: The drawing depicts multiple stylized floral elements on a light beige background. A central brown stem branches out to the left and right, supporting several different flowers and leaves. On the left side, there are three star-shaped flowers in shades of red and pale pink, with narrow green leaves extending from their stem. Towards the top center, a large blue flower with rounded petals has white and blue spotted inner petals and yellow-tipped stamens radiating from the center. Above and to the left, a green leaf with dark green, zigzag edges sits near the main stem. In the bottom right corner, part of a large red flower with bright pink and white highlights is partially visible, extending out of the frame. The composition is spaced out, with elements connected by the central brown stem, and the individual flowers and leaves rendered in soft, gradient colors.
title: Crewel Embroidery
